user.title: Local Web UIs
user.description: Open the web UIs of local devices and sites inside Home Assistant. Devices that link to a local web page (for example ESPHome with web_server) are discovered automatically; other sites can be added afterwards with "Add web UI".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Local Web UIs is already set up.

data_description.discovery: List devices whose integration links to a local web page (their "Visit" link), such as ESPHome devices with web_server, WLED or printers.
data_description.link_device_pages: Point the "Visit" button of those devices at their web UI here, so it also works away from home. Can be changed per device in the panel. Turning it off restores the original links.

user.title: Add a web UI
user.description: Any web page your Home Assistant server can reach: a device, a router, a printer, another server.

data.name: Name
data.trusted_acknowledged: I understand that a trusted web UI can act as me in Home Assistant

data_description.mode: Isolated keeps the page away from Home Assistant; it cannot read Home Assistant's data or act as you. Trusted runs it with Home Assistant's own origin, which some pages need (for example ones that rely on browser storage APIs the isolation shim does not cover), but the page's scripts could then control Home Assistant as you. Only use it for pages you fully trust.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off for devices with self-signed certificates.
data_description.username: Optional. Sent as HTTP Basic authentication so you are not prompted.
data_description.password: Optional. When editing, leave empty to keep the stored password.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: Add a sidebar entry that opens this web UI directly.
